statement: The EIA daily WTI Cushing spot price, FRED series DCOILWTICO, records at least one observation at or above 110.00 USD per barrel dated between 2026-10-26 and 2026-11-20 inclusive. Reference: 103.27 on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DCOILWTICO, fetched on the deadline, shows any observation dated 2026-10-26 through 2026-11-20 inclusive with value 110.00 or higher; otherwise false. Reference: 103.27 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO observation dated 2026-10-26 through 2026-11-20 is below 110.00 USD per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
